fusions.name: Shake Dry
fusions.desc: Shakes the water off your scales in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 water damage with a 35% chance of [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold as Pondwater
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 30 frost damage, ignores resistances and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds, with a 50% chance of [Frozen] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Water Off the Back
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Skim the Pond

riders.text: you cross it faster than you cross ground
and blows slide off you while you are on it
and you mend faster while you stand on it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground.
